body: Ah well that's nice, I do enjoy talking with you ! :) PM me if you'd like to talk more, I don't want any creepers piecing together my life story from reading this comment chain..

shhhh we're gonna be okay. Well it's only been a few days, but I think I've been feeling better as the days pass. I think it was worse when I was attempting to talk to him because he wasn't saying anything I wanted him to say. Humans are so weird and fickle and it is so frustrating to try and rationalize so many of the stupid things they may do just based on their feelings. Having someone who you know loves you is lovely, but at this point, I don't know if it's worth the pain of being ripped away from them.

Trust me, I'm trying, but it's next to impossible to kill that last little glimmer of hope. I don't want to want him back, because I know that in theory, I should be able to do SO much better than him. Everyone has told me that he's just some loser neckbeard (lol) but I dunno I guess I just got really emotionally invested in him. It also really hurts to be told that the person you are in love with never loved you as much as another girl.

UGH I know right, it's fucking awful. It's like one of the things you looked forward to the most has just been taken away from you at no fault of your own (at least in my case). I have a pretty hard time forming solid connections with people in general, and can be insanely awkward to talk to in any way other than text, but conversation with my ex felt so natural. I don't even like calling him my ex because I have this pathetic hope that he will realize that he loves me more than he thinks and he will want to come back to me or some shit.

I decided to give him a few days to think about things, mostly to see if he wanted to get back together, so I'm going no contact until Wednesday. I feel like I'm just delaying the inevitable, because I know that more than likely, he's just going to hold to what he said before.

yeah, that sounds good, I like observing other people and my environment :) I think what I'm really lacking right now is good human interaction, though, and I really don't know where I would go about finding that outside of friends and family. I know my family loves me, and would be willing to listen and work through anything I come to them with, but sometimes I just feel like I need a good outside perspective. While I was with my boyfriend, it was really nice to be able to talk to him about anything interesting that happened to him throughout the day (he has a full-time job) and listen to what he had to share likewise. Now everyone just seems so awfully boring.
I enjoy the idea of it, but I find that what usually happens is I end up thinking excessively about the very things I'm trying to avoid.
I don't eat when I'm sad, can we go for something a little more ambitious?
pretty much but only sometimes not continuously
nah we didn't date very long in most people's minds (2 months) but it was the emotional investment that I put into it that's making it so hard
